node.title: Re: Accent file names issue
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It's been a while since I did battle with non-ASCII filenames on Windows, but from what I remember, Windows has some "quirks" in how it returns non-ASCII filenames to Perl, which is probably the root of the problem. While I haven't used these modules directly, I have seen them recommended in various other threads on similar topics ([1113737], [1162804], [1170561], [1195063]), and so I just wanted to highlight the AM's suggestion of [mod://Win32::Unicode]. Also two of those threads mention [mod://Win32::LongPath] as an alternative.

Update: More references: [1220286], [1210032], [1078587]
